description: This is a unit test source file written in C++ using Google Test framework for testing SystemServices plugin functionalities in a software project. It contains various test cases for different APIs, event subscriptions, and mock interactions related to system reboot info, firmware management, power modes, wake-up reasons, and other system settings.

classes.name: SystemServicesTest
classes.description: Test fixture for the SystemServices plugin unit tests, setting up mock dependencies and plugin initialization.

classes.name: SystemServicesEventTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture for testing system event subscriptions and notifications.

classes.name: SystemServicesEventIarmTest
classes.description: Specific test fixture for IARM event registration, handling system state and power mode change events.

methods.name: TestedAPIsShouldExist
methods.description: Verifies that all expected API methods are present in the handler.

methods.name: SystemUptime
methods.description: Tests the requestSystemUptime API and validates the response format.

methods.name: PendingReboot
methods.description: Tests the fireFirmwarePendingReboot API and its subscription event mechanism.

methods.name: Firmware
methods.description: Tests firmware info gathering APIs like getLastFirmwareFailureReason and getDownloadedFirmwareInfo.

methods.name: Timezone
methods.description: Tests multiple time zone change notifications and getTimeZoneDST API.

methods.name: InvalidTerritory
methods.description: Verifies invalid input handling for setTerritory API.

methods.name: ValidTerritory
methods.description: Verifies correct behavior of territory change notification and getTerritory API.

methods.name: rebootReason
methods.description: Tests retrieval of system reboot reason and info.

methods.name: Telemetry
methods.description: Tests Telemetry opt-out status retrieval and setting.

methods.name: SystemVersions
methods.description: Checks retrieval of system version info.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen_IARM_fail
methods.description: Tests failure scenario for setting bootloader splash screen via IARM call.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen_IARM_success
methods.description: Tests successful scenario for setting bootloader splash screen via IARM call.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen_empty_path
methods.description: Tests handling of empty path input for splash screen.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen_invalid_path
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid path input for splash screen.

methods.name: MocaStatus
methods.description: Tests Moca (Multicast over Coax) status enable/disable and query APIs.
